Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 2
Reason for Mistake: The Planner drew a final conclusion from a Bing search snippet without verifying the underlying source(s). The snippet incorrectly stated that Alexandre Berthier’s grandfather was Jean-Baptiste Berthier (and even misattributed the “Chief of Staff to Napoleon I” role). Proper verification would show the paternal grandfather is Louis-Alexandre Berthier. This was an over-reliance on a single, possibly garbled SERP summary and a failure to cross-check authoritative sources before finalizing.
